notes: Full v2 extraction across all 6 categories, then reorganised into a subjects[] hierarchy (30 subjects total). Each <slug>.json is now { ..., subjects: [{ slug, title, order, workflows, firstPrinciples }] }. BSP gained two canonical flowchart workflows (bsp-2018-classification-pathway, bsp-s3-stepwise-treatment) and three first principles (bsp-013, bsp-014, bsp-015), then was aligned with the latest BSP guidance: bsp-full-diagnosis (1999 classification) and bsp-non-surgical-therapy (2016 framework) were deleted; bsp-bpe-screening-adult, bsp-bpe-screening-children, bsp-antimicrobials-perio, bsp-supportive-periodontal-therapy, bsp-referral-decision and bsp-012 were rewritten to use 2018 stage/grade/status terminology and the S3 stepwise framework.
